'''Luke with lightsaber My begginner Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Luke with lightsaber (GPN)|Luke with lightsaber]]
* '''Published:''' 10 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi War Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassiwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4: Massassi War Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat Yavin 4 Massassi War Room lightsab.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

don't have a lot of card and I want to buy a couple of card that could help me have a better deck

The published list has 56 cards.

== Strategy ==

my strategy is to try to control tatoine with my jedi's and also to have a fair presence in space, because the guy I play with have a lot of fighter and charaters in his deck (vader, boba fett, 2 imperial starship, couple of tie-fighter and advance, imperial leader and pilot). i have the death star docking bay cuz my partner always star the game with the death star.Those card are probably the best I got (I have aroun 200 card) and I'm looking to get a few more that can help me. any suggestion would be greatly apreciate. Thanks
